title: Vegan French Lentil Stew
description: A hearty and comforting stew made with French lentils, onions, carrots, and celery. Perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onion, carrot, and celery and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the French lentils, stir fry sauce, and 4 cups of water to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
